content: Very Difficult to Use. This app was a terrible purchase. The interface looks outdated and the app is very difficult to use. Don't waste $5 on this unless an update is released.

Was great. Don't update!!. I have been using this app for about six months and it has been great. It has really helped with my budget. However today I downloaded the update that is supposed to "fix" all the bugs. Unfortunately it no longer works at all now, and crashes every single time I try to use it. I tried deleting it and then downloading it again, nothing is fixing this horrible update and now all of the months of data are gone. Horrible!!

I used to like this, but recently starts changing my $ total. I use this app everyday for all my transactions. But one day I noticed my money was different the. What I remembered it to be the last time I opened it. I had to go through and search for anything I may have forgotten to plug in...I did not forgot anything so I just did n adjustment for the difference. This has happened several times since so I am now down with this app! How can I keep track of my money if it keeps changing how much I actually have!?

Doesn't quite do what I want. This app does have some useful features, like the ability to display cash out in various graphic forms, however:
Several versions ago, a passcode was added for security. I tried disabling it, but after having the app demand that I enter a passcode when I had none every time I opened it and having to reinstall daily to get into the app, I relented... Having to enter a passcode every time I get distracted and leave the app or set my phone down (with 5 dogs and one child, that happens a lot) is a source of frustration. And it takes a long time to enter my gas purchase as I drive away from the pump. 
I have never found a way to alter the weekly total for my budget without a delete and reinstall. The fact that I got a$50/week raise doesn't mean that the raise is retroactive for 3 years! And if I want to decrease my budget to make me save more, that is also not retroactive!
Just my two serious pet peeves...

What use is this l, really. Do not buy. The advertisements are BS.

To many Bugs in IPhone. Yo many Bugs in My IPhone, this app needs updates.

Needs update since end 2014. As previous recent comments, this app crashes when going back, once you go to [MARCA]. It is very annoying, if it wasn’t for this I would keep using it, now I’m looking for another app.

DON'T upgrade yet to ios10 version. It is trying to convert transactions but keeps crashing after getting 3/4 of the way through. Tried 4 times and crashed every time.

New version is terrible. I'm very disappointed with this new version. It does not auto-populate all options of categories and payments when selecting a vendor as it used to do, on the budget screen I can't jump easily from one month to another. After using it for 5 years, I'm dropping it.
Horrible redo. Don't waste your time with this app. Layout is horrible, function needs multiple steps just to add an expense, they should have never changed it and I was stupid enough to update mine.
Hate the new update 9.0. Can I have the old version back?

I can no longer recommend this app at all.

NOOOO WHYYY!???. I use this app daily. I solely rely on it for organizing my spending. This new update is NOT usable! It's a unorganized mess too many features with zero way to use them effectively. Absolutely horrible!! Bring back the old version.. you have made this the worst app on the market!. Best finance app in the [MARCA].

Worst update. I have been a user of this app for years and it has helped to track my spending and budget better but my goodness, this new update is just the worst! The last version did not need all these fancy, color looks, bring back the old one! This is unacceptable!! I don't write reviews but this is important!!
👎👎👎 UPDATE. I just don't believe this version is an update it is Horrible.

Worse update ever. Not only did they remove a lot of key features that separated them from their competitors, but it's far more complicated to use now. In fact, I'm actually a bit discouraged now more than ever. [MARCA], the only thing that was missing from the prior version was just [MARCA].

Terrible - Bring back the old version. There's so much wrong with this that I can't even break it down.  The ear of use and readily accessible information is gone.  Unable to find what I used to when I needed to.  Now I'm left with charts and graphs at the top of each page. Can't find totals, past days, etc.  if there are things there it's multiple clicks and pages to find it.  Terrible.  I'll be finding another app.

Downgrade. The app has become so complicated it takes three times as long to do anything. Recording expenses has become painful since the entries dont come with default entries and the app forces you to fill every field. Icons, which were really helpful in helping you find the categories quickly are now gone. I like the modern design but I'd downgrade to the old app if I could.
Messed up the currency in my accounts. Now it shows all accounts in local currency. I can't tell how much I owe in an account because it doesnt show the real currency. This update is horrible and renders the app useless.
Horrible update. Wow!! What a horrible update.  Completely destroyed the best financial app. I want my refund!!!!!! This is crap is horrible!!!!!!

Update ruined app. I've been using this app daily for almost a year. It was so useful and exactly what I needed. The new version ruined everything. Now I can't use the app and all the time I spent keeping track of everything for the past year has been a waste....
disappointed in update 😩. i really liked this app for tracking spending and budgeting, but the recent update has me looking for a new app -- bummed.

New update destroyed the app I loved. Purchased the app several years ago and rated the app 5 stars. This new update is trash. They completely destroyed the intuitive functions and there is no option to go back. They offer a free version of the old app which I'll switch to.

From the best to the worst.. The recent update killed this app. Period. 
RIP.

This WAS a great app. I'm a user of this app since 2009. I was entirely pleased until they released this awful upgrade which renders the app completely useless. Navigation between screens is terrible. I used to open the app and see my monthly budget on the first screen. Now, I don't know where it is and using the new date swipe bar is HORRID. You used to just swipe to see another date, now you use this bar which goes haywire with every swipe. I never get the day I want. But what's the point anyway, I can't see my budget of income and expenses on the screen!!!

I don't recommend this personal finance app anymore. I'm buying another one.

You ruined this app!!!. If you wanted to make such a big change, you should of made a new app!!! you ruined all my previus transactions and made it imposible to use!!! I have been using this for 6 years!!!
So sad..... I regret upgrading too.... can I have my old app back?
Horrible Update. You took an app that was intuitive and easy to use and made it a messed up piece of crap. I'll be looking for another budget app to replace this.
Need a new app. I made the mistake like so many others and updated. Time to look for a new app.
Disappointing. Not having the ability to see current account balances is a major flaw. I need to find an app that provides this, like they used to have.

Terrible update. Use iXpenseIt Lite. This update has ruined the simplicity of the app. I will be trying to find a replacement right away. It used to allow me to quickly see my overall budget as I enter in new expenses now I have to click all around to find it. Dates are stacked on top of each other which can be very confusing. I no longer see my daily averages or anything else that was easily accessible. I could access multiple budgets with a single swipe and now that is all lost.
Miserable changes.
Download iXpenseIt Lite, it's still the old format.

BAD BAD BAD UI. BAD UI! RUBBISH UI! Make this APP un-useable at all!!!
AND, ALL my category are LOST after upgrade!!!
Can I rate zero star to it?

Revert us back!!!. What were you thinking!!? You ditched the monthly detail listing where there was always a running total at the bottom and you could scroll up and down through all the categories...why on earth would you ditch that feature??? Pointless if I can't see if I have posted all my transactions or not.
Also way more steps to post one measly transaction. You guys really messed up.

Update Ruined App. The update is more of an overhaul, not even really the same app that I liked. Excessive inputs required to get to where you want to be. In general is now overly complicated for personal use. At least I got to use it for some time, so I got my money's worth imo. I would not recommend the new version.
Terrible update. I hate the update. Got used to using it for certain data and the update killed it. Going to be looking for a different app.
Please give us back great app.... Downgrade a fix old bugs. This is not upgrade, but a new app. And very bad one...

ruined app. Another review stating I want my old app back.  This went from being very useful to useless.  It is too hard to use, and logging milage is now an extreme chore.  They need to download the old version and rethink what they are doing here.

TERRIBLE. What happened to mileage?  What are all these screens and clicks to enter an expense?  What a confusing, dysfunctional mess!  This app used to be fairly decent - before the "upgrade". The good reviews must be faked by someone inside the company - nobody could like this.

Got worst. It WAS my favorite app had practical functions easy to use , well organized. I do not know why it turn ugly , really which to have the old version back. It destroy all all the set up I had
HORRIBLE!!

Ruined a great app!. I used this everyday to track my debit card spending and now it is impossible! I recommended it to my whole family and they ruined my very favorite app.  Have to find something else to use instead😞
Hate it. I hate a new update, it's so complicated.

A Pretty design with lost functionality is NOT an upgrade! VERY Disappointed and Frustrated!!. Really? How can you call this an upgrade? Totally agree with all the other negative reviews. It is NOT just about figuring out where the old features are in the new design. It IS about the fact that you have actually REMOVED much of the functionality and ease of use that made the old version so attractive.

In addition to the good examples of this loss of functionality already mentioned in other negative reviews, I rely heavily on the currency conversion feature for my frequent overseas travel. I used to be able to maintain a customized list of most used currencies, but now all I get is the master list of ALL world currencies that I have to scroll
through for each transaction. Are you kidding me?!? What a colossal waste of time just because of this simple loss of functionality! 

I'm sorry to say I'm looking elsewhere for a replacement to this app.
The worst update!. Use to love this app, now I hate it! Thanks for the worst update ever😡
I want the old version back. This update is NOT user friendly. In the old version I could easily see my daily budget. With this one I can not find my balance, so frustrating.

No update until...terrible. I've been using this app for almost 8 years. No significant updates occurred until the most recent version, and it's absolutely horrendous. I became accustomed to being able to bring up my account balance on the home screen. Now I have to dig to find the current balance, and I'm still not sure if it's the current-most or if I'm looking at just the current month's tally. This is a blow to the long-standing user. If I wanted this kind of interaction, I would stick primarily with my [MARCA] app, and I might as well just use that since it provides my credit score and crosschecks all my active accounts. I don't want to select a vendor every time. I want my default settings and familiar movements within the app; those that I have grown familiar with over the course of several years. Bad update.

Horrible update. Ruined this app. The was the best 5 star app until some idiot decided to update it & completely ruined it. It's really complicated to use now & can't find and organize my old transactions. I'm so upset as to why they did this. Bring back the old version!!!! Don't know why the hell they did this. I don't recommend this app anymore

#worstupdateever. This was the app that I recommended to people the most, and they have completely ruined it.  The black and white picture feature plus a prettier look with the same user experience was all they needed to do.  [MARCA] fail!
Sad to see the simplicity gone. I used to use this app for all my transactions, now with the horrible update I can not even add an expense without having to select so many options like vendor...

I really liked being able to view the monthly calendar and seeing my monthly expenses clearly. I'm not using as a balance checkbook, just want to see my expenses only.

Please return to the version before the last update. This update destroy my favorite app. I can't transfer between my accounts and I can't track my budget biweekly. This update is terrible and I will destroy years of datas 😔

The new update is bad. This used to be a really great app, but now it's just another app I'll leave off my device. 

Navigation is difficult, and quick entries aren't possible anymore. Also, reporting is not as intuitive as it was.

Please fix or give us the option to downgrade.

Time to find a new expense tracking app.

I can't beleive they checked a beta with actual users before releasing this. My complaint for today... when entering debits for previous dates, the app now lists them as an expense on the date of entry to the app, not the date I entered it was actually paid. I hope I adjust, but with a number of years of data on this app, it is very disappointing and a royal Pain In the...!!!

From what i can tell there is no new budget button, all of my old info is so messed up i just want to start from scratch but from what i can tell there is no way to do that. Why can I not edit 1 instance of a recurring transaction as before, it appears this version will change all future transactions?  Why is there no "owners manual" for this version, the only thing i can find is for previous versions?  A good app completely ruined, bummer.
Don't like it at all. Bring back the old version or give me my money back. I would of never paid 4.99 for this joke. Such a failure
Worthless. I want my money back.

I started over thinking it was a fluke but it happened again about a year later when I updated iOS. Fool me twice shame on you fool, fool me three times ain't gonna happen. Useless.

Bring back old features.. In the older versions, you could change the name of "cash flow Report" to "expense Report" but in this new version, I can't seem to find that option. Also, I can't make an expense report by selecting the end date. It's either weekly, monthly, etc. for example, if I want to submit an expense report for items purchased on November 9th and November 10th, I used to be able to put the start and end date as such. Now is not the case. Unless you can still do that and I just don't know how? 

Please don't fix stuff unless it's broken. I don't understand why these features are missing?

New Version Not Good. They’ve completely redesigned the user interface for this version and have totally missed the mark.  The app used to be incredibly intuitive.  Now it is a bit maddening trying to figure out how to do things.  Additionally, things like getting it to default to the current date have been eliminated.  And it’s a bit buggy.  It’s too bad because it used to be one of the best apps out there.  But sadly no more.

Seriously flawed update. Too busy partying over the holidays to fully test your update? I'm no longer able to enter an expense for yesterday, January 4. It automatically registers as January 5. How could this be overlooked if you were doing the most basic testing, much less thorough testing, before releasing your update?

Manager. The new version is very difficult to use

Still not as good as the old [MARCA]. QUESTIONS: Why does the Cash flow not function as fully as in the old ap? Why is there no Annual Cashflow view as there was in the old [MARCA]?? That Was a SIGNIFICANT Tool.It can only be read monthly. 
What are the "in APP purchases?" In the old [MARCA] they added functionality and usefullness but they are greyed out on the [MARCA] page. Why are they there, and are they AVAILABLE.????

I wish you would finish the job of making this as robust as the old [MARCA], many are still mourning it. If you do it will be a boon, as there are not many great competitors out there.

Homescreen changes make it less useful. In an old version of your app it showed me all my charges for the month on my home/today screen, so I knew I shouldn't spend a lot of money if I had some reoccurring charges coming up that would bring me to my budget limit.

With the current version I only see the charges that have been paid from the start of the month to today, so I don't have a good sense of if I can spend a lot for the rest of the month, or if that money is already spoken for.

Can you tell me how to fix this problem? Do I have my settings wrong, or does your app just no longer offer that feature?
Bye, it's time to change. Colorful but very bad update. The report is not user friendly. I can't tract my money like before.

Saving my business life!. I've been looking for some way to track my numbers and in particular my cash for years. I couldn't be happier with being able to create my own Account headings to particular to my business. Now I know what comes in and what goes out on a daily basis it couldn't be easier.

Recently the family sync feature hasn’t been working consistently and to correct they recommend logging out and logging back in. Now I’m locked out of my account because of an error on their side that says “The data couldn’t be read because it isn’t in the correct format”. Unfortunately this app has been having troubles recently.

It appears that is no longer possible and years of my financial data is now gone.

IXpenseIt crashed all data is lost. It is a disaster. Disaster - app has crashed and has not ten fixed. IXpenseIt crashed a couple of days ago. Does not work. All my financial data is lost. It is a disaster

Support is horrible. I have the multi device syncing subscription for only two devices and the # of transactions are different making the balances in the account different. I have followed every trouble shooting tip, sent back up files from both devices and I now get no response from support.
No support. App used to work great, but my phone app and iPad app no longer communicate. Also the auto cropping feature for photographing receipts is inefficient.

Can’t save scanned receipts. For some reason, a recent update has caused the “Keep Scan” button not to show up at the bottom of the screen. There’s no way to directly save a scanned image other than taking a picture, saving it to photos, and then uploading it to the app. I emailed customer service, sending them a screen shot, and they never responded. I’ve used this app (pro version) for years. This is the first time I have been disappointed with its functionality and more disappointed with the silence from customer service.

Hijacks all your txt files. I have used this app for over 14 years and it was a good app. However, just recently, within the last year, they did something where now if you have any .txt (text) files on your device and you try to open these, it will automatically open the iXpenseIt app. I have had numerous conversations with this developer over the period of many months and they arrogantly refuse to do anything about this. Additionally, I have contacted [MARCA] and they also do not care about this issue. Think about what this app does with any text you have that would have seriously private information!  They have access to it. It’s not right. DO NOT USE. Class action lawsuit should be filed. 

   I want to be clear about something. There is no way to open any text file unless you either delete this app or you do a long press and then select QuickLook.
